findings.claim: 10-K 競爭章節列出『AI model developers and providers of AI products and services』為競爭對手之一，並稱業務特徵為快速變化與新型顛覆性技術。
findings.excerpt: Our business is characterized by rapid change as well as new and disruptive technologies. We face formidable competition in every aspect of our business, including but not limited to, from: •general purpose search engines and information services;

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素自述：新技術可能使競爭者提供相似或更好的體驗，消費者可能改變取得資訊的方式，降低現有產品效用與使用量。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: As new and existing technologies continue to develop, competitors and new entrants may be able to offer experiences that are, or that are perceived to be, substantially similar to or better than ours, and the consumers may change how they obtain information online, potentially reducing the utility of our existing products and services.

findings.claim: MarketBeat 報導 Alphabet 仍居美國搜尋 88% 市占，同時有資料顯示網站點擊下降 8.9%，並提及年輕用戶轉向 AI 聊天機器人的疑慮。
findings.source: MarketBeat: AI takes over search, is Google's dominance at risk

findings.claim: Motley Fool 引 Statcounter：Google 全球搜尋市占約 90%，Bing 低於 5%。
findings.excerpt: According to statcounter, it has 90% share of the global search market. Bing has less than 5% share. This is why investors have no reason to worry.
